card.name: Start of "stinging" and "un-" words
card.fires_on: The word start "st" in "stinging" after "prick or" or "slight" in blood-draw descriptions. It also fires weakly on "un" starting words like unrelenting, unattractive, unmanageable, and on linking words after a descriptive phrase.

modes.label: Stinging sensation
modes.description: The "st" before "inging" when describing how a needle stick feels.
modes.example: Others will feel only a prick or<< st>>inging sensation.

modes.label: Un- words after a link
modes.description: The "un" starting a negative adjective after a verb or "or".
modes.example: Patients with MBC should receive treatment until disease progression or<< un>>manageable toxicity.

modes.label: Scattered linking words
modes.description: Small words like "and", "led" or "over" in literary or religious prose.
modes.example: and their great<< and>> true shepherd
